description: Conservation of the AllF-specific His389 insert and summary figure of SucD functional-residue mapping
code:
import requests, numpy as np, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
UA={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}
ACC={"SucD_ECOLI":"P0AGE9","AllF_ECOLI":"Q47208","YahF_ECOLI":"P77187","FdrA_SALTY":"Q8ZR75"}
SEQ={k:"".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60,headers=UA).text.split("\n")[1:]).strip() for k,a in ACC.items()}
# AllF family-specific insert carrying His389 (PF00549 insertion, absent from SucD)
print("AllF  378-400:", SEQ["AllF_ECOLI"][377:400])
print("FdrA  378-400:", SEQ["FdrA_SALTY"][377:400])
i=SEQ["YahF_ECOLI"].find("GRPHP"); print("YahF  GRPHP at", i+1 if i>=0 else "absent")
for mot in ["GRPHPM","RPHP","GRP"]:
    print(mot, "AllF:",SEQ["AllF_ECOLI"].find(mot)+1, "FdrA:",SEQ["FdrA_SALTY"].find(mot)+1, "YahF:",SEQ["YahF_ECOLI"].find(mot)+1)
print("YahF 380-410:", SEQ["YahF_ECOLI"][379:410])

# ---------------- summary figure ----------------
rows=[("CoA  C1'/adenine  G15",  "PF02629 c10","G200","G196","G200","cons"),
      ("CoA  phosphate    T17",  "PF02629 c12","S202","S198","S202","semi"),
      ("CoA  phosphate    G18",  "PF02629 c13","G203","G199","G203","cons"),
      ("CoA  phosphate    S19",  "PF02629 c14","T204","T200","T204","semi"),
      ("CoA  adenine      Q20",  "PF02629 c17","Q207","Q203","Q207","cons"),
      ("CoA  pantetheine  V39",  "PF02629 c37","L226","T222","L226","semi"),
      ("CoA  pantetheine  P41",  "PF02629 c39","G228","G224","G228","sub"),
      ("CoA  3'-phosphate K43",  "PF02629 c41","D230","D226","D230","sub"),
      ("CoA  adenine      Y72",  "PF02629 c70","A257","A253","A257","sub"),
      ("CoA  adenine      V73",  "PF02629 c71","F258","L254","F258","semi"),
      ("CoA  ribose       P74",  "PF02629 c72","P263","P259","P263","cons"),
      ("CoA  ribose       S81",  "PF02629 c79","K270","K266","H270","sub"),
      ("CoA  pantetheine  I96",  "PF02629 c94","L285","C281","L285","semi"),
      ("CoA  pantetheine  T97",  "PF02629 c95","F286","F282","F286","sub"),
      ("CoA  2'/3'-OH     E98",  "PF02629 c96","L287","L283","L287","sub"),
      ("CoA  thiol S-S    C124", "outside PF02629","none","none","none","miss"),
      ("PO4 power helix   R153", "PF00549 c3","T338","C348","T337","sub"),
      ("PO4 power helix   S154", "PF00549 c4","G339","G349","G338","sub"),
      ("PO4 power helix   G155", "PF00549 c5","G340","G350","G339","cons"),
      ("PO4 power helix   T156", "PF00549 c6","T341","T351","T340","cons"),
      ("GHAGA loop        G246", "PF00549 c101","Q466","Q482","Q465","sub"),
      ("CATALYTIC His     H247", "PF00549 c102","Q467","Q483","Q466","sub"),
      ("GHAGA loop        A248", "PF00549 c103","I468","S484","I467","semi"),
      ("GHAGA loop        G249", "PF00549 c104","A469","Q485","A468","sub"),
      ("GHAGA loop        A250", "PF00549 c105","T470","M486","A469","semi")]
cmap={"cons":"#2d6a4f","semi":"#95d5b2","sub":"#e07a5f","miss":"#8d99ae"}
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11.5,10))
ax.set_xlim(0,4); ax.set_ylim(0,len(rows)); ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.axis("off")
ax.text(0.02,-0.9,"E. coli SucD functional residue",fontsize=10,weight="bold")
ax.text(1.12,-0.9,"Pfam column",fontsize=10,weight="bold")
for x,n in zip([2.0,2.65,3.3],["AllF (Q47208)","YahF (P77187)","FdrA Stm (Q8ZR75)"]):
    ax.text(x,-0.9,n,fontsize=10,weight="bold",ha="center")
for i,(lab,col,a,b,c,st) in enumerate(rows):
    y=i+0.5
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0.0,i+0.06),4.0,0.88,color="#f6f6f6" if i%2 else "white",zorder=0))
    ax.text(0.02,y,lab,fontsize=9,va="center",family="monospace",
            weight="bold" if "CATALYTIC" in lab else "normal")
    ax.text(1.12,y,col,fontsize=8.5,va="center",color="#444")
    for x,v in zip([2.0,2.65,3.3],[a,b,c]):
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((x-0.27,i+0.12),0.54,0.76,color=cmap[st],alpha=0.85,zorder=1))
        ax.text(x,y,v,fontsize=9,va="center",ha="center",zorder=2,
                color="white" if st in("cons","sub","miss") else "black",
                weight="bold" if "CATALYTIC" in lab else "normal")
hs=[plt.Rectangle((0,0),1,1,color=cmap[k]) for k in ["cons","semi","sub","miss"]]
ax.legend(hs,["identical","conservative","non-conservative substitution","no equivalent residue"],
          loc="lower center",bbox_to_anchor=(0.5,-0.075),ncol=4,frameon=False,fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("Pfam HMM column mapping of E. coli SucD catalytic and CoA-binding residues\n"
             "onto AllF, YahF and Salmonella FdrA (UniProt numbering; 1CQI numbering = UniProt - 1)",
             fontsize=11.5,pad=16)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
